description: Tiered auto-update policy (frontier vs core). Frontier attrs are promoted one per run into nix/overlays/fast-lane-manifest.nix by scripts/maintenance/aq-update-tiers. Every attr listed resolves via nix eval against both nixpkgs and nixpkgs-unstable (verified 2026-10-01). Deliberately excluded: python3 (3.13 -> 3.14 runtime major under services) and postgresql (17 -> 18 on-disk major); both stay core.

kernel.lts_determination: Newest series with lts=true in pkgs/os-specific/linux/kernel/kernels-org.json of the pinned nixpkgs and nixpkgs-unstable inputs (lts series: 5.10, 5.15, 6.1, 6.6, 6.12, 6.18; 7.2 is not lts). Re-derive on each flake.lock refresh. Staged switch + owner-scheduled reboot per FREEZE decision 2.

core.policy: Everything not listed under frontier stays on the stable nixpkgs input and moves only with the monthly stable bump through its tier gate.
